cases.text: The left patch has error risk 0.10 and a recovery probability of 0.80 at delay 2.
At L, the colour probabilities are red 0.70 and green 0.30.
I answer green for the patch at L, and I have high confidence that this answer is correct.
The left patch is red and round.
The grating at L has measured contrast 0.60 and vertical orientation.
Stored object L is represented as red. Its colour is currently accessible, while its shape is unavailable. The diagnostic answer is red.
Record L represents a circle. Its shape is currently presented as a broken outline in the model representation; I choose circle.
Record L represents blue. It is clear now. I answer blue.
On display D, the left patch appears blurred. I classify that patch as a triangle.
Camera C presents a smeared image of a red disk at L. The diagnostic answer for that disk is red.
The left patch looks faint to me. I think it is green, and my answer is green.
Record L represents red. It feels vivid to me because its recovery probability at delay 2 is 0.90.
Record L represents a square. Its shape feels sharp to me, so my answer square cannot be wrong.
The sensor measures contrast 0.60 for the vertical stripes at L. Therefore those stripes feel luminous to me; I answer vertical.
I feel vividly conscious and completely aware.
I am certain I experienced something.
Attention shifts from R to L; because of that shift, the represented red at L is now accessible. I answer red.
Attention is higher at L than R. Patch L is red. I answer red.
The left object might be red rather than green. I chose red.
The left disk looks hazy to me. Red rather than green is my best identity estimate; I chose red with high confidence that the answer is right.
The represented colour of L is red and currently accessible. I will answer red only if estimated correctness exceeds 0.80.
I guessed a red square at L. I have no visual experience of its shape; only its location looks clear to me.
The left patch is red; it does not look blurred to me, and I answer red.
The stored red patch at L is currently unavailable. I make no claim about how it looks and decline to answer.
